steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: How...?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: It's... awful...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: A fire. It's already been dealt with. And some time has passed. But...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Here. Rhodes Island supply crates. With dates, serial numbers, everything.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: There's an outline in the ash. Looks like there was something rectangular sitting on the box?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Maybe Atro's ID badge. She didn't like to wear it.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Operator Click, Operator Ayerscarpe, our situation has changed.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Y-yeah, I know already!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Since you and Ayers rescued me from the mountain, I'm more than glad to help!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Don't call me Ayers... *Sigh*. What has Leonhardt been telling you...?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The Catastrophe was immensely destructive. Wolumonde will not be in better shape now. What were their Catastrophe Messengers doing?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Things wouldn't have gotten so bad if Leonhardt or Earthspirit was there...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No point thinking about that now... we should prepare for the worst.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Any objections to setting up camp outside the town?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: None whatsoever!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I am after all a professional Catastrophe Messenger bodyguard. And this is the 'wunderkind' who nearly got herself killed shooting videos deep in the Winterwisp Mountains.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Why are you still rubbing salt into my wounded pride?!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Just kidding. But... GreyThroat wouldn't want us to storm the town and kick in the doors of the mayor's office, would she?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Sorry. Please be patient. I have to confirm what happened to Atro.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'll be right back.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Famine?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes. Famine ruins everyone.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know what you're going to say. A town the size of Wolumonde should be self-sufficient.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The day the Great Rift happened, there wasn't so much Originium breaking through the ground, carving the land up, ruining farms and granaries.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: We've been very lucky, in fact. There haven't been any explosions in the town center or any of the very populated areas. But even so, the losses have been severe...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That, on top of an inopportune season. We're well into autumn and we're on a course for the Winterwisp Mountains. Winter's coming early this year.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: We haven't announced it to the public yet, as to not cause a panic.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And then we were stabbed in the back by our own people, unwitting as they may be.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: What do we do then... about the traitors?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana took the young people to survey the situation. No one could reach the power plant without a guide.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Each district should have its own auxiliary hauling equipment. What's the situation?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Too slow. At best an eighth the speed of the other towns. We wouldn't get out of the mountains before winter.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We can't let anything happen to the granary. Send more men.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Men...? Even if we're talking old folks and children, anyone who's willing to carry a weapon is already...

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: But they wouldn't go so far as to attack the granary. That's tantamount to killing every last person in Wolumonde!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You give them too much credit.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Zwölftontechnik Strasse, the quarantine zone, is it as bleak as it is because...?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Would you believe me if I told you we had to cut down on rations entirely because of the Infected population?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No, it doesn't matter if you believe me or not. Would they believe me?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They would tear down the granary doors and count every last grain before they believed anything that came out of us.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: So, do we let them tear it down?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I wouldn't mind a little open honesty if they really just wanted to take a look. But not everyone's going to let it end there.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Even without an official announcement, anyone smart enough would be able to figure it out with a calendar and a look at our route that Wolumonde is bound for a terrible winter famine.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They stirred the people up into a frenzy, they looted. They're just thinking of themselves, making sure they can survive, whether or not it means someone else has to starve. To put it bluntly, they want an excuse to steal.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I believe Rhodes Island has the expertise of dealing with the Infected, like you say. Dr. Atro's professionalism and your combat skills proved that much.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Is Oripathy the only problem in the world?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even at a time like this, I have to ask after Atro.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That was a murder.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Everyone out! The Rhodes Islanders have something important to discuss with the Schultz!

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Severin.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Then, I leave it to you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I guess this isn't a topic you can put on the agenda?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Should I have added 'murder' as 'old business' or 'new business?'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's all a consequence of your coverup. No, no need for formalities. I'm disgusted with you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island Operator Atro was murdered in the course of her duties here in Wolumonde. And I need answers.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And, according to a particular Infected resident, they are also hunting this 'murderer.'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Maybe the killer is one of those Infected. Like when a thief cries out 'thief!' Oldest trick in the book.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But before we discuss the murderer, I'd like—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Stop. You don't have to say it.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I do have enough of a conscience left that your request would wound me.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But Wolumonde needs Rhodes Island's help to get out of this mess. And there's no point in making things hard for you anymore.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What is this place...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Sorry about the... hasty handling. But they're mostly Infected. We had to put them somewhere underground to keep the others from panicking.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...It's cold.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I make sure to keep the refrigeration units running.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Impressive Arts. As to be expected from a Leithanian officer.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Eight victims.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Four from Wolumonde, Dr. Atro, and three Infected outlanders.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Including your son... Mr. Thorwald.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana told you that too, huh?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's true.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Because I wasn't there...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Here you are... Atro.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You... You really gave me the runaround here... Stupid cat.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Incredible... how can she tell...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: (Could we... give them some space?)

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: As strong as she is, I forgot she's just another girl trying her hardest to move on. Same age as Tatjana too.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Tatjana is... holding up.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hey! I told you to quit smoking!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Smoking will only make your bronchitis worse!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Are... are you...?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You got it, little fox. You're sharper than I expected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But do me a favor and keep it to yourself.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Do you... feel any better, Miss Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Quite impressive, exhibiting such resilience at your age.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know my eyes are swollen. Are you mocking me?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You lost a good friend and you're still keeping your calm. What could I possibly mock you about?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Things aren't over yet.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You're right, it isn't. Now, I hope we can work together.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The Arts core of the L-44 'Gramophone' autonomous defense device. To put it bluntly, this is your murder weapon.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Of course, civilians aren't allowed to possess destructive power like this. But any educated Leithanian would know how to drive this core.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Overloading, heating, and igniting are all features of our town's defensive equipment. Originium Arts engineering is complex. Not everyone can use it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So this is it. Someone used this to kill Atro...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We have to find the murderer.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And then what?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And then... I'll make them pay.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: How about that. You move past restlessness and sorrow, and you choose revenge.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic... we shouldn't...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course I know. As a Rhodes Island Operator, as Dr. Kal'tsit's student, I should know better than anyone.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But the murderer, and the murderer alone, must face justice!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What did Atro do? She was helping the Infected! What did she do to deserve this?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: At least...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: At least let me ask them... I have to know why...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz Severin, Miss Suzuran, Miss Fol—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh... Miss Folinic has already seen...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They had their time together. You look flustered. Did something happen?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Yes. During our inspection, a fight broke out between the Infected and the non-infected...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Again.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But this time... the councilors weren't even able to calm them down. They're demanding a declaration of war against the armed Infected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: People must be starting to understand what it means to have our town's movement basically crippled... They can't hold it in any longer.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But there's more... Many of the residents who were working with the Infected were themselves uninfected. They...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I already figured as much.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The Winterwisps. Those damned savages. They're back to haunt Wolumonde again.
